text:
Alex Chen: taking over swing shift now. quick rundown — embed-queue spike in eu-west1 (partial P2), regen canary latency up ~3x for a small % of requests, two infra deploys scheduled in ~12m. i’ll own embeds for first 20m, handing regen to @Simon.

Tanvi Patel: ack, looking at embed-queue. eviction rate jumped, replicas are thrashing. increasing burst pool and bumping eviction threshold. watching metrics.

Simon Gray: on regen canary; capturing traces now. suspecting KV cache miss storm from bad prefix. have rollback candidate (v1.12.3) staged if latency keeps climbing.

Maria Lopez: pinged infra to pre-warm extra instances in eu-west1; they said ~7m ETA for ready. also queued a limited-scale config change to reduce concurrency on worker pool (will hold until we see if pre-warm helps).

Alex Chen: thanks — Tanvi, if eviction rate doesn’t fall after pool bump let me know and i’ll trigger cache-evict-protect flag. Simon, keep me posted on traces. Maria, note the deploy window, we should hold the 2 non-critical deploys until this stabilizes.

oncall-bot: alert -> embed-queue.euw1.qps spike at 2026-03-18T18:12:02Z, rate +240% over baseline. incident-id: INC-20260318-0453.

Tanvi Patel: pre-bump snapshot: pod memory 82%, eviction-rates 0.37 -> post-bump memory 68% after new instances joined. eviction rate down to 0.09. good signal but still watching tail latency.

Simon Gray: traced a handful of slow requests — big KV miss from agent X that sends long prefix (~2.5k tokens). adding guard to strip long prefixes in canary to test. will deploy a hotfix patch to canary in 6m.

Alex Chen: plan for next 30m: 1) keep burst pool up and monitor evictions (Tanvi), 2) Simon to push prefix-guard to canary and collect post-patch p95/p99, 3) Maria to hold non-urgent deploys and confirm pre-warm completion, 4) i'll update the incident ticket with mitigation steps and timeline.

Maria Lopez: pre-warm done (eu-west1 instances ready). held the two deploys and notified owners.

Tanvi Patel: eviction rate stable ~0.05 for 5m, queue depth dropping. will start a controlled scale-down if stable for 10m.

Simon Gray: canary patch rolled at 18:19:35Z. initial p99 reduced from 1.8s -> 0.62s for the traced subset. keeping canary at 12% traffic for another 9m.

Alex Chen: thanks team. i'll leave this thread open for the rest of the shift. next steps: if anything regresses, escalate to infra and prepare rollback. otherwise i'll mark INC-20260318-0453 as mitigated after 30m of stability. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled deploys (svc-cache-fix, ui-minor) placed on hold by Maria Lopez.

Simon Gray: noted — i'll extend canary window to finish telemetry capture.

Tanvi Patel: leaving watch for now, will rejoin if evictions or queue depth moves.

Alex Chen: handoff to evening oncall in 40m — leaving checklist in the ticket. thanks all.
